title: Requests for Information, Restriction and Suspension of a Personal Sender Account
content:
Compliance may issue a request for information on an active Personal Sender Account at any time; issuing it restricts the account at once, with the restriction reason matching the request's topic — source of funds, identity, transfer activity or KYC refresh.

## Answer window and reminders

The answer is due by the request's due date, which is the issue date plus the current level's answer window in calendar days, and reminders go out every reminder interval of the level, in calendar days, while the request is open.

## Periodic KYC review

A periodic KYC review falls due on the account's next periodic review due date. When no accepted refresh documents are logged by that due date plus the level's KYC refresh grace in calendar days, compliance issues a request for information on the topic KYC refresh.

## Lifting the restriction

The restriction is lifted only by compliance, once the documents answering the request are accepted. A support agent logs the documents but never lifts the restriction.

## Suspension

- **Non-response.** The account is suspended for non-response only once the request for information was issued more than the level's answer window in calendar days ago with no accepted answer. The window is counted in calendar days from the date the request was issued, and an answer accepted on the due date itself is still on time.
- **Rejected submissions.** The account is also suspended when the number of rejected document reviews dated on or after the issue date of the most recent request for information reaches the level's limit of rejected submissions.

**Boundary (hypothetical dates, 14-day answer window).** A request issued on 1 April is due on 15 April. An answer accepted on 15 April is on time. The account may be suspended for non-response from 16 April, when the request was issued more than 14 days ago, and not on 15 April.

## While the account is restricted

| The customer can | The customer cannot |
|---|---|
| cancel transfers that have not been paid out | book personal transfers |
| receive refunds | request a limit review |
| request statements | receive an upgrade |
| submit documents | |
